title: Record each shipped change in a history fragment file instead of a Change Log row and a version bump
description: Record each shipped change in a history fragment file instead of a Change Log row and a version bump
acceptance_criteria: After change check materializes a change, each affected module has specs/<module>/history/<change-id>.md with the change id, date and title, and the spec's version: and Change Log are byte for byte unchanged; two changes to one module shipped on separate branches merge with plain git (no merge driver) without a conflict in that spec; specsync check refuses a malformed fragment and names it; specsync history <module> prints the frozen table rows unchanged followed by one row per fragment

answers.constraints: MERGE-1 (no conflict on version: or the change-log row), MERGE-4 (no looser gates), the #741 lesson that the record of a change in a module is the evidence that materialization ran, and the #843 stale MODIFIED refusal, which stays as it is
